decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir sits close to the firm's core hydraulic steel engineering and represents sunk development investment, so only one year of modest website presence is too early a signal to abandon a product that fits the established flood-control offer.

The energy management system embodies the firm's publicly announced direction toward digital networking and energy recovery, so management would attribute any slow uptake to long municipal procurement cycles and persist with it.

The overflow flap gate is the most visibly committed product, with its own dedicated web page, and it lies close to the core offer, so dropping it after one year would contradict the firm's public commitment and its prior investment.
